questions.stem: Which of the following is not a feature of minimal change disease
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) Oliguria is a feature of nephrotic syndromes not nephrotic.

questions.stemHtml: Liver biopsy of a patient suffering from chronic hepatitis and respiratory diesease is as follows. What is likely diagnosis
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (A) The histology shows PAS positive globules within hepatocytes which is seen in alpha 1 antitrypsin deficiency

questions.stemHtml: A 22-year-old basketball player dies during a match. Autopsy shows left ventricular hypertrophy; microscopy of heart is as below. True about his condition is

options.label: C
options.text: Hypertension are risk factors for this disease

questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (D) The patient is having hypertrophic cardiomyopathy

questions.stem: True about Acute Respiratory Distress syndrome (ARDS) are all except?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (A) ARDS is noncardiogenic pulmonary edema which is exudative edema

questions.stem: Pleomorphic adenoma originates from
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) Ductal reserve cells

questions.stem: A patient presents with periorbital edema. Serum albumin is reduced. Urine shows 3+ proteinuria, no casts. Light microscopy shows sclerosis in few glomeruli. Electron microscopy shows effacement of foot processes. What is likely diagnosis?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (A) Sclerosis in glomeruli + Effacement is seen in FSGS.

questions.stemHtml: Histological examination of a testicular tumor is as follows. Which marker will be not expressed in this
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) Cytokeratin is a marker for embryonal carcinoma. The histology shows seminoma.

questions.stem: A 60-year-old male presents with severe chest pain and elevated troponin levels. Histology of the heart shows neutrophilic infiltration and coagulative necrosis. What stage of myocardial infarction is this?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) Neutrophilic infiltrate is seen between 1-3 days post MI

questions.stem: True about Smoking and lung diseases are all except

options.label: D
options.text: Increased risk of small cell carcinoma

questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (A) In Emphysema the antitrypsin is getting degraded in lungs thus there is a feed back to liver to secrete more antitrypsin.

questions.stem: True about autoimmune gastritis are all except

options.label: D
options.text: Macrocytic changes can be seen in epithelium

questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) Autoimmune gastritis decreases the risk of esophageal adenocarcinoma

questions.stem: A child presents with fever, conjunctivitis, strawberry tongue, and cervical lymphadenopathy. Which complication is most feared in this condition?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) the patient is suspected of Kawasaki disease which includes risk coronary artery aneurysms.

questions.stem: Which of the following is principal activity in early phase of Atopic asthma
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) Early phase is due to mast cells and histamine

questions.stem: Marsh grading for celiac disease is based on all except
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (A) Marsh grading is a histological grading which uses the other 3 options.

questions.stem: Which of the following chromosome is not involved in polycystic kidney diseases?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) Chromosome 4 (PKD2) and Chromosome 16(PKD1) cause ADPKD, PKHD (Chromosome 6) causes ARPKD

questions.stemHtml: Histological examination of a bone tumor is as follows. True about this is

options.label: C
options.text: Osteoblastic progenitors are cell of origin

questions.answerText: Osteoblastic progenitors are cell of origin
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) cell of origin of osteoclastoma is osteoblastic progenitor.

questions.stem: A patient suffering from cirrhosis secondary to hemochromatosis now presents with dyspnoea. Echo shows dilated ventricle. You are suspecting a complication which of the following can it be
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) Hemochromatosis patients are more likely to develop dilated cardiomyopathy.

questions.stemHtml: A 25-year female was diagnosed of breast carcinoma; histology is as given below. Her mother also had breast carcinoma at a young age. Which mutation is likely to be found in her
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (D) CDH1. Histology shows Indian file pattern which is seen in lobular carcinoma

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about pathogenesis of pneumoconiosis

options.label: B
options.text: Smoking has no role in pneumoconiosis

options.label: C
options.text: Coal worker pneumoconiosis is most common

options.label: D
options.text: Crocidolite are more likely to cause it

questions.answerText: Crocidolite are more likely to cause it
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (D) Particle size should be 1-5 micron, smoking can alter properties of dust particles thus enhance pathogenecity, silicosis is most common. Crocidolite are straight and rigid fibre of asbestos which are more pathogenic than Chrysolite (curly fibre)

questions.stemHtml: A patient who presented with hematuria and edema during the course of hospital stay has developed anuria. Blood urea is 60 and creatinine is 8. Renal biopsy immunofluorescence is as below. What is likely mechanism of the disease
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) . the IF shows linear deposits which is seen in Goodpasture syndrome

questions.stem: True about carcinoids is

options.label: A
options.text: Lung carcinoids are benign and cause syndrome

options.label: B
options.text: Ileal carcinoids are malignant and do not cause syndrome

options.label: C
options.text: Appendicular carcinoids are benign and do not cause syndrome

options.label: D
options.text: Ileal carcinoids are benign and cause syndrome

questions.answerText: Appendicular carcinoids are benign and do not cause syndrome
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C)

questions.stem: A 45-year female is troubled by patechiae purpura for many months, now she presents with recent onset of asthma, there is reduced ejection fraction. Which finding is likely to be seen in serology of this patient?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) Patechiae purpura with asthma and cardiomyopathy is suggestive of Churg Strauss syndrome which shows PANCA

questions.stem: Which of the following marker is not expressed in adenocarcinoma of lung
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (A) CK5/6 is positive in Squamous cell carcinoma

questions.stemHtml: Histological examination of a renal tumor is as follows. Which of the following is true about this?
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) The image shows well defined cytoplasmic borders with perinuclear clearing seen in chromophobe RCC.

questions.stem: Premalignant lesions involved in carcinogenesis of HNPCC are
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C)

questions.stem: Which of the following is used in PAP stain 1) Haematoxylin 2) Methylene blue SF 3) Eosin 4) Orange G 5) Light green SF
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B)

questions.stem: Primary pathogenesis of hypertensive aneurysm is
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (B) Hypertension leads to narrowing of Vasa vasorum (due to arteriosclerosis) which leads to ischemic necrosis of muscle of vessel wall leading to aneurysms.

questions.stemHtml: Histological examination of a patient suffering from steatorrhoea and weight loss is as follows. What is likely pathology involved
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) The biopsy shows lipid vacuoles in epithelial cells which is seen in abetalipoproteinemia which is due to trans epithelial defect of triglycerides.

questions.stem: Which of the following cancer syndromes there is inherited nephroblastoma due to gain of function mutation 1. Beckwith Wideman syndrome 2. VHL syndrome 3. WAGR syndrome 4. Denys Drash Syndrome 5. Tuberous sclerosis
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (A)

questions.stemHtml: Histological examination of a thyroid tumor is as below. Which mutation is likely in this tumor
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C) histology shows amyloid deposits which is seen in Medullary carcinoma, associated with RET mutation.

questions.stem: Perivascular pseudo rosettes are seen in
questions.solutionHtml: Correct Answer (C)
